obligations.title: Signed manifests for all governed artifacts
obligations.failure_mode: Derivation runs on unverified governance content

obligations.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
obligations.failure_mode: Data exposed in storage or on the wire

obligations.title: Per-service workload identity, no shared account
obligations.failure_mode: Blast radius spans services on credential compromise

obligations.title: Full audit trail per case
obligations.failure_mode: Decision cannot be reconstructed or defended

obligations.title: Runtime observability and tracing
obligations.failure_mode: Failures are invisible until a human notices

obligations.title: PII detection and redaction on model egress
obligations.trigger: data_sensitivity in (confidential, regulated) or exposure == external
obligations.failure_mode: Personal data reaches a model provider

obligations.title: Prompt and model version pinning
obligations.failure_mode: Output changes silently between runs - reproducibility lost

obligations.title: Structured output schema gate on every model response
obligations.failure_mode: Unvalidated model output enters the design pack

obligations.title: Retrieved content treated as data, never as instruction
Evaluation set with a pass threshold before release
Human decision required before an irreversible commit
obligations.failure_mode: An irreversible action is taken autonomously

obligations.title: PHI handling controls (DoH / HAAD)
obligations.failure_mode: Protected health information handled outside clinical controls
